name: WRN RecQ like helicase

function.text: WRN encodes bifunctional 3'-5' exonuclease/ATP-dependent helicase WRN [Includes: 3'-5' exonuclease; ATP-dependent helicase]. Annotated molecular activities include exonuclease activity and 3'-5' exonuclease activity. It participates in mismatch repair and telomere maintenance.

germline.text: Strong or definitive GenCC assertions link constitutional variants to Werner syndrome (autosomal recessive).

somatic.text: This gene is included in cancer-panel definitions, but a disease-specific somatic association has not been assigned from the alteration-context sources reviewed for this draft.

germline_associations.mechanism: Autosomal recessive; definitive GenCC assertion from ClinGen. Allele-specific mechanism requires review.
